Mit über 660 Mitarbeitenden weltweit sind wir Marktführer in diesem Bereich. Unsere Firma, die Hogrefe Digital Solutions GmbH, entwickelt das Hogrefe Testsystem (HTS), eine Webplattform für umfassende psychologische Online-Assessments und beschäftigt mehr als 60 Personen. Unsere Testverfahren helfen beispielsweise dabei, Lernschwierigkeiten bei Kindern frühzeitig zu diagnostizieren, sie werden im HR-Bereich für Eignungsdiagnostik eingesetzt oder unterstützen psychologische Fachkräfte, um Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen auf ihrem Weg zur Genesung zu begleiten. review_candidates.title: Senior Automation Engineer (Manufacturing Systems)
review_candidates.description: Work with advanced platforms and technologies driving the next generation of pharmaceutical manufacturing If you're an automation engineer who enjoys complex systems, modern technology and continuous learning, this is an opportunity to work with some of the most advanced manufacturing platforms in the industry. At Moderna, you'll support and enhance a highly connected digital manufacturing environment spanning Emerson DeltaV, MES, PLC/SCADA systems, historian platforms, OT infrastructure and emerging technologies that are helping redefine how medicines are manufactured around the world. Unlike many automation roles focused primarily on maintaining legacy systems, this position offers exposure across a modern technology ecosystem with opportunities to influence upgrades, solve complex integration challenges, support new technology implementation and contribute to the continued evolution of a growing manufacturing operation. As Moderna continues to expand its global mRNA platform, you'll join a site that combines biotech innovation, advanced automation and digital-first manufacturing, providing the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise while working on systems that have a direct impact on patient outcomes. We're not looking for someone who simply wants to maintain existing systems. We're looking for someone who is excited by complex technology, thrives on solving challenging problems and wants to help build what's next. If you're energized by advanced technology, modern manufacturing and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a growing global biotech company, we'd love to hear from you. About Moderna Joining Moderna means helping shape the future of medicine. You'll work alongside exceptional global teams advancing mRNA science while building a career that combines cutting-edge technology, advanced manufacturing and meaningful impact for patients around the world. Moderna is strengthening Australia's biotech landscape through a long-term partnership focused on pandemic resilience. Our Melbourne-based mRNA vaccine manufacturing facility will support rapid response to future health threats while creating skilled jobs and developing local talent. We welcome professionals ready to help advance global health security. This role sits at the intersection of automation, manufacturing, engineering and digital technology. You'll take ownership of critical GxP automation and digital manufacturing systems, supporting their full lifecycle from implementation and commissioning through validation, operation, maintenance and continuous improvement. Working within a highly automated, technology-driven manufacturing environment, you'll help sustain reliable and compliant operation across manufacturing equipment, control platforms, manufacturing execution systems, historian platforms and associated digital integrations. You'll also have opportunities to explore emerging technologies, including Generative AI, and how they can be applied within a regulated manufacturing environment. Here's What You'll Do Take technical ownership of critical automation and digital manufacturing systems across the Moderna Clayton site. Provide hands-on troubleshooting and operational support to ensure manufacturing reliability, compliance and performance. Act as a Subject Matter Expert for assigned systems, driving technical decisions and lifecycle management activities. Support and enhance platforms including Emerson DeltaV, MES, PLC/SCADA systems, historians and associated OT infrastructure. Design, configure, test and implement system changes using a risk-based and compliant approach. Drive automation upgrades, system improvements and technology lifecycle initiatives. Solve complex integration challenges across manufacturing equipment, control systems and digital platforms. Contribute to automation projects from design and commissioning through validation and operational handover. Lead technical activities for system modifications, upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives. Support GMP, GAMP and Computer System Validation requirements across assigned systems. Lead or support investigations, deviations, CAPAs and change controls. Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Validation, IT/OT and external vendors. Share technical expertise and help strengthen automation capability across the site. Explore opportunities to leverage emerging digital technologies and Generative AI to improve engineering, knowledge sharing and operational performance. The Key Moderna Mindsets You'll Need to Succeed "We act with dynamic range, driving strategy and execution at the same time at every step." "We digitize everywhere possible using the power of code to maximize our impact on patients." Who Thrives at Moderna? This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about automation, excited by emerging technologies and motivated by the opportunity to work across a highly connected manufacturing environment. You'll Thrive Here If You: Love solving complex technical problems. Enjoy learning new technologies and expanding your expertise. Want exposure across automation, digital manufacturing and integrated production systems. Prefer building and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them. Are curious about how manufacturing equipment, control systems, data platforms and digital technologies work together. Enjoy collaborating across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation and Digital teams. Take ownership, drive solutions and see challenges through to completion. Are excited by the opportunity to influence a growing manufacturing operation and help shape its future. Here's What You'll Bring to the Table Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science or a related technical discipline. 7+ years of experience designing, implementing and/or supporting manufacturing automation systems. Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments is strongly preferred. Experience from highly automated advanced manufacturing environments will also be considered. Demonstrated hands-on experience with Emerson DeltaV DCS. Strong experience with PLC and SCADA platforms such as Rockwell, Siemens, FactoryTalk, Wonderware, iFix or similar technologies. Experience supporting MES, historian platforms and system integrations within a manufacturing environment. Strong working knowledge of cGMP, GAMP and Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements. Demonstrated capability in complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis and resolution of automation and integration issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and operational stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business priorities. Demonstrated commitment to Moderna's values of Bold, Collaborative, Curious and Relentless. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Syncade MES, PI Historian or similar digital manufacturing platforms. Experience with IT/OT networking, virtualization, Active Directory and SQL environments. Understanding of industrial automation protocols including EtherNet/IP, Modbus and OPC. Programming experience using Structured Text, Function Block Diagram, Sequential Function Chart or Ladder Logic. Experience supporting serialization, track-and-trace, robotics, vision systems, batch management or related technologies. Experience with FAT, SAT, CQV, validation and regulated system lifecycle activities. Understanding of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes and equipment, including fill-finish or drug product manufacturing technologies. As part of Moderna's commitment to workplace health and safety, this role may be subject to pre-employment and periodic medical assessments, in line with relevant legal and operational requirements. Our Working Model As we build our company, we have always believed that an in-person culture is critical to our success. This role is 100% onsite, reflecting the importance of being physically present to support the work, collaborate closely with colleagues, and contribute to our site-based operations. Working onsite enables real-time collaboration, strong team connections, direct mentorship, and the hands-on partnership needed to deliver our mission. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute and make a meaningful impact. Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment. Pay & Benefits At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs A holistic approach to well-being with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support Family building benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support Generous paid time off, including vacation, bank holidays, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown Savings and investments to help you plan for the future Location-specific perks and extras The benefits offered may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Moderna and the country where you work. About Moderna Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world. By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities. We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S. If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities. Moderna is a place where everyone can grow. If you meet the Basic Qualifications for the role and you would be excited to contribute to our mission every day, please apply! We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We’re focused on attracting, retaining, developing, and advancing our employees. By cultivating a workplace that values diverse experiences, backgrounds, and ideas, we create an environment where every employee can contribute their best. Any applicant requiring an accommodation or adjustment in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should contact the Accommodations and Adjustments team at leavesandaccommodations@modernatx.com.

review_candidates.description: Who We Are Asset Ocean is a subsidiary of Encavis, one of the leading independent producers of electricity from renewable energy sources. We provide a central solution for the renewable energy sector to manage data from multiple solar and wind farms. Our mission is to improve data management and accelerate decision-making by providing high-quality data access and actionable business insights - helping Encavis scale its decentralized generation portfolio through intelligent data use. Build the platform behind smarter energy decisions As a Platform Engineer, you will be part of Asset Ocean, the team building the data product behind Encavis’ ambition to become one of Europe’s leading power producers and enablers of smarter energy trading. Working in a small, highly collaborative and fast-moving environment, you will help shape a platform that is continuously evolving, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability and frequent delivery. You will operate at the intersection of DevOps, data engineering and platform architecture, contributing directly to a system that underpins critical business decisions. This role offers you the opportunity to take real ownership from day one, work closely with a driven and hands-on team, and build technology that has a tangible impact on the energy transition. What You Can Expect Platform Ownership & DevOps Excellence: You take ownership of CI/CD pipelines, release processes and QA automation to enable fast, reliable and confident product delivery. Data Platform Enablement: You support the data team by improving dbt automation, warehouse scalability and shared tooling, ensuring a robust and scalable data platform. Reliability & Observability: You establish high standards for system reliability and observability (e.g. SLIs, incident response), reducing operational issues and improving system stability. Security & Platform Integrity: You ensure strong security standards, including secrets management, dependency scanning and secure access control based on least privilege principles. Platform Architecture & Development: You design and build scalable platform components such as messaging systems, event buses or integration layers in close collaboration with development teams. AI & Innovation Integration: You actively integrate AI-driven solutions into platform development and contribute to innovative approaches beyond standard implementations. Your Profile Professional Experience in Platform Engineering: You have hands-on experience owning and operating platform, DevOps or SRE systems in production environments. CI/CD & Cloud Expertise: You have a strong background in CI/CD processes and infrastructure-as-code, ideally within Azure environments. Architecture & Development Skills: You are able to design cloud setups, collaborate closely with developers on system architecture and implement platform components yourself. Data Platform Understanding: You bring experience working with data platforms, data warehouses or closely supporting data teams. Customer-Oriented Mindset: You treat internal developers as your customers, communicate clearly and focus on delivering practical, high-impact solutions. Hands-on & Impact-Driven Approach: You focus on delivering value pragmatically and efficiently rather than over-engineering solutions. Language & Remote Environment: You communicate fluently in English and feel comfortable working in a fully remote, international setup.
